entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Don't be so rough with me!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Enough of that!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You said you know how we can do[n]something about Kamoshida, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It has to do with what this guy was[n]talking about earlier. You'll need to[n]attack his castle.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That castle is how Kamoshida views[n]this school.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He doesn't realize what happens in there,[n]but it's deeply connected to the depths of[n]his heart.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Thus, if the castle disappears, it would[n]naturally impact the real Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What'd happen?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A Palace is a manifestation of a person's[n]distorted desires. So, if that castle were[n]no more...
His desires would go too.
He'd become an honest man.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Precisely! You sure pick up things fast!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!? H-He's gonna turn good!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But... is that really gettin' back at him?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Erasing a Palace essentially means[n]forcing the owner to have a change[n]of heart.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: However, even though their warped wants[n]disappear, the crimes they committed[n]remain.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Kamoshida will become unable to bear[n]the weight of those crimes, and he'll[n]confess them himself!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You for real!? That's possible!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And since the Palace will no longer exist,[n]he'll forget what we did there as well.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Not only will we be able to bring[n]Kamoshida down, but there won't[n]even be a trace of our involvement.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's amazing! You are one[n]incredible cat!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: True, except for the cat part!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So? How do we get rid of the Palace!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: By stealing the Treasure held within.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Stealing...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll tell you more once you agree to go[n]ahead with this. It's my most valuable,[n]secret plan, after all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you want to help me out, I'll gladly[n]teach you. What's your call?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Our luck's runnin' dry lookin' for[n]witnesses. Guess we have no choice[n]but to go along...
You're right.
There's no other way...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Good.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, right. There's one more thing[n]I should tell you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we erase a Palace, there is no doubt[n]that the person's distorted desires will[n]be erased as well.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But desires are what we all need in order[n]to survive.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The will to sleep, eat, fall in love—[n]those sorts of things.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you gettin' at?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If all of those yearnings were to vanish,[n]they'd be no different than someone[n]who has shut down entirely.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: They may even die if they're not given[n]proper care.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They might die!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Will you listen to everything I have to say[n]first?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Would their death be our fault?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Aren't you determined enough to face[n]those kinds of risks?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey... What do you think?
We'll have to risk it.
I don't want to kill him.
I'm interested.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: O-Of course not...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sheesh... I come all this way, and this is[n]what I get. It's not like anyone will ever[n]find out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's not the point!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If we just go around secretly doin'[n]whatever we want, we'd be no better[n]than that effin' Kamoshida...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Isn't this your only option?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I'll come back later. Make sure you've[n]made your decision by then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, we're gettin' all worked up for[n]nothing... Dammit!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'll try and see if I can figure out[n]another way...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's get outta here.
